name: itembank-dsh-pin
description: Version pin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent console embedded by the itembank Agent tab (plan 17A-06). Not a build input: this directory exists so the exact dsh dependency tree is reproducible with `npm ci`. The override is not a preference: a fresh resolve of dsh 0.1.0-rc.7 fails with ETARGET because a transitive package demands @aws-sdk/core ^3.977.9, which the registry does not carry (highest is 3.977.8, checked 2026-08-21). 3.977.8 is the version the working install actually has.
